newsitem.title: UK: Xenova signs Parke-Davis discovery accord.
newsitem.headline: Xenova signs Parke-Davis discovery accord.

text.p: British biotechnology company Xenova Group Plc said on Thursday it had agreed on a further drug discovery collaboration with the Parke-Davis arm of Warner Lambert Co of the U.S.
In a statement Xenova said it would provide chemicals from its library of natural products, which includes fungi, bacteria and plants, for Parke-Davis to screen for potential drugs.
Last year Warner-Davis became a partner in another library of Xenova natural chemicals.

Under the agreement, Xenova said it would receive research, milestone and royalty payments for any drugs developed through the collaboration. It would also have exclusive marketing rights in Europe to any cancer drugs resulting from the collaboration.
